concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer: T008 requires 'Prepend the limitations caveat from docs/LIMITATIONS_MASTER.md (T009) to the report header' and its verification asserts the caveat appears in the header, but T009 (which produces LIMITATIONS_MASTER.md) is listed AFTER T008. The dependency note 'T009 can run in parallel with T005–T007' also omits T008, yet T008 is a consumer of T009's deliverable. Reorder T009 before T008 (or before T005) and update the execution-order line to 'T009 before T008'.
